title: Electric Vehicle Regional Practice Course

parameters.Cup positions and gap (cm): Not applicable — cups are not part of Electric Vehicle rules
parameters.Track width and surface: 2.0 m wide smooth, level, and hard surface

notes: Regional tournament setup with standard 6.00 m target distance, 14.0 s target time, 2.0 m water bottle placement from start, and 2.00 m bottle line distance beyond target.
setup: Ensure the track surface is smooth, level, and hard, with a width of at least 2.0 m.
Mark the Start Point with an approximately 5 cm x 2.5 cm tape.
Mark the Target Point at 6.00 m from the Start Point along the imaginary center line with a 5 cm x 2.5 cm tape.
Place the non-optional 500ml Water Bottle centered on the imaginary center line at 2.0 m from the Start Point.
Mark the Bottle Line with an approximately 2.5 cm width tape at 2.00 m beyond the Target Point, perpendicular and centered to the imaginary center line, spanning at least 1.0 meter wide.
